name: Delft Bouldering Association
description_short: A student-run bouldering and rock climbing club for all skill levels.
description_full: The Delft Bouldering Association is a vibrant climbing community open to all skill levels. We meet twice a week at the local climbing gym for social climbing sessions. Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced climber, you'll find a welcoming group of enthusiasts. We organize monthly competitions and outdoor climbing trips to nearby areas.

name: Delft Board Game Society
description_short: A casual board game community that meets weekly for strategy games, party games, and RPGs.
description_full: We're a friendly group of board game enthusiasts meeting every Thursday at a local café. We play everything from complex strategy games to quick party games. Our collection includes over 100 titles, and newcomers are always welcome. We also host monthly tournaments and game design workshops.

name: TU Delft Photography Club
description_short: Photography enthusiasts sharing techniques, organizing photo walks, and collaborating on projects.
description_full: A community for students and staff who love photography. We organize monthly photo walks through Delft, host workshops on technique and post-processing, and collaborate on creative projects. All skill levels welcome—from smartphone photography to professional DSLR work.

name: Rotterdam Running Club
description_short: A diverse running community with routes for all fitness levels through Rotterdam's parks and waterfront.
description_full: We're Rotterdam's largest running club with over 120 active members. We organize runs of varying distances every weekend, from 5km leisurely jogs to 20km+ challenging routes. Our routes showcase Rotterdam's beautiful parks and waterfront. Perfect for building fitness while making new friends.

name: Rotterdam Tech Startup Hub
description_short: Networking and collaboration space for tech entrepreneurs, developers, and innovators in Rotterdam.
description_full: A vibrant hub for anyone passionate about technology and entrepreneurship. We host monthly talks from successful founders, organize pitch events, and provide a collaborative space for building projects. Great for making connections and finding co-founders or team members.

name: Rotterdam Jazz Collective
description_short: A community for jazz musicians and enthusiasts organizing jam sessions and concerts.
description_full: We bring together jazz lovers and musicians of all levels. Weekly open jam sessions welcome both experienced performers and curious listeners. We also organize quarterly concerts and workshops with visiting jazz educators.

name: Den Haag Cycling Group
description_short: Cyclists of all levels exploring the beautiful Dutch countryside around Den Haag.
description_full: Whether you're a casual commuter or an ambitious cyclist, join us for Sunday rides exploring the scenic routes around The Hague. We offer different pace groups so everyone can participate comfortably. Routes range from 30-80km.

name: Den Haag Film Club
description_short: Indie and arthouse film enthusiasts who meet bi-weekly to discuss and watch films.
description_full: A community of cinephiles passionate about independent and arthouse cinema. We meet bi-weekly to watch curated indie films followed by thoughtful discussions. Our selection spans documentaries, international films, and experimental work.

name: The Hague Meditation & Wellness
description_short: A mindfulness community offering guided meditation, yoga, and wellness workshops for students.
description_full: Build inner peace while connecting with others. We offer guided meditation sessions for beginners through advanced practitioners, weekly yoga classes, and wellness workshops. A serene community dedicated to mental and physical wellbeing.
address: Community Center Achter Kerk, Den Haag
